content: I need to find information about the number of "Reference Works" in each Life Science domain compared to Health Sciences on ScienceDirect as of 2022, including their sample standard deviations. Please search the web and find: (1) what are the Life Science domains and how many Reference Works each has, (2) how many Reference Works Health Sciences has, and (3) what the sample standard deviations are for each category. Look for tables or data with standard deviations.
